<?php
declare(strict_types=1);

/**
 * Authentication handler for application
 * Production-optimized, secure, maintainable
 */

// Environment configuration (use .env in production)
define('AUTH_ENV', getenv('AUTH_ENV') ?: 'production');
define('ADMIN_USERNAME', getenv('ADMIN_USERNAME') ?: 'admin');
define('ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH', getenv('ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH') ?: '$2y$10$92IXUNpkjO0rOQ5byMi.Ye4oKoEa3Ro9llC/.og/at2.uheWG/igi'); // Example hash for 'admin123'
define('DEV_BYPASS_KEY', getenv('DEV_BYPASS_KEY') ?: null);

/**
 * Authenticate a user
 * 
 * @param string $username
 * @param string $password
 * @return array{success: bool, message: string}
 */
function authenticateUser(string $username, string $password): array {
    // Validate input
    if (empty($username) || empty($password)) {
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Username and password are required.'];
    }

    // Admin authentication
    if ($username === ADMIN_USERNAME) {
        if (password_verify($password, ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH)) {
            return ['success' => true, 'message' => 'Welcome, admin!'];
        }
        return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'Invalid admin credentials.'];
    }

    // Add additional user authentication logic here (e.g., database lookup)
    return ['success' => false, 'message' => 'User not found.'];
}

/**
 * Check for dev bypass access
 * 
 * @return bool
 */
function checkDevBypass(): bool {
    if (AUTH_ENV === 'production' || DEV_BYPASS_KEY === null) {
        return false;
    }

    return isset($_GET['devkey']) && $_GET['devkey'] === DEV_BYPASS_KEY;
}

// Handle dev bypass if enabled
if (checkDevBypass()) {
    echo json_encode(['success' => true, 'message' => 'Dev access granted.']);
    exit;
}
